findings.title: collect_projected_edges AtomAdmissionError catch downgrades V1 to unprojectable-fact on the helper path only
findings.finding: Query _reconcile_fact_occupancy raises AtomAdmissionError(TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_SCHEMA_VERSION) for schemaVersion=1, and collect_projected_edges catches any AtomAdmissionError as resolutionLimitations kind=unprojectable-fact. That branch is reachable by calling the helper with mutated occupancy_inputs. It is not reachable on public execute_graph_query after complete close_run: a selected V1 sidecar is refused by retained Run admission (identity REGISTERED_RECORD:# at seed-time; REFERENCE_IDENTITY / evidence.corrupt if a sealed proof is later rewritten). Root contract law is therefore satisfied on the public path: V1 is global admission refusal, not an omitted edge.
findings.consequence: Treating the helper catch as whole-Run proof would falsely claim V1 is omitted. Public execute_graph_query does not emit a success body with unprojectable-fact for selected V1.
findings.reproducer: output/probes/independent_occupancy_probes.py v1_helper_vs_fullrun; output/probes/v1_close_run_admission_probe.py. Helper: mutate occupancy_inputs sidecar to schemaVersion=1 then collect_projected_edges → unprojectable-fact note occupancy admission TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_SCHEMA_VERSION. Seed-time V1 through close_positive → AdmissionError REGISTERED_RECORD:#. Sealed proof rewrite → execute_graph_query QueryRefusal HOST.IO_FAILURE/evidence.corrupt.
findings.minimalRemedy: Keep the public law as close_run refusal. If the catch is later tightened, do not convert AtomAdmissionError into omitted edges; leave helper tests labeled helper-only. Not a MUST for this scoped public occupancy identity correction.

findings.title: Default mapped-file fixture imports source census changed foo → foo+bar; semantic 18 does not prove census unchanged
findings.finding: Author stated default mapped-file fixture unchanged. Default imports_occupancy remains mapped-file and the mapped-file payload/sidecar still occupy file a.ts. Semantic replay 18 passed, including imports-file-first-party-exists (fail/1) and imports-file-none-false-on-mapped-target (fail/6). Those cases do not inspect imports source census.

The extra bar source subject is occupancy-identity-neutral for mapped-file file occupancy (query still projects a.ts; atom matchingFactIds still agree). It is fixture coupling for exact-id/unknown-sidecar modes, not a new graph kind and not host census authority.
findings.reproducer: Independent probe census-default-imports-scope-includes-foo-and-bar. Author.patch hunk on evaluator_semantic_fixture.v3.py subjects=E.cset([foo]) → [foo, bar].
findings.minimalRemedy: If later needed, keep mapped-file source census as the importer set for that mode, and only expand to {foo,bar} for exact-id/unknown-sidecar. Not required to accept the occupancy identity correction.

findings.title: Author atom-run-agrees controls use verdict/findingCount; peer matching-fact identity agrees; unmapped findingCount 0 is not known miss
findings.finding: Owner checks owner-imports-*-atom-run-agrees assert verdict==fail and findingCount>=1, or findingCount==0 for unmapped. They do not compare query factId to predicate witness matchingFactIds. Independent public execute_graph_query after close_run shows exact identity: mapped-file, exact-id, unknown-sidecar, and single-kind references query factIds equal atom matchingFactIds. Unmapped exists-target: all 7 file predicates are indeterminate with uncertainFactIds, findingCount 0, verdict pass (composition gating: indeterminate without blocking deficiencies does not flip Run verdict). Query omits with unprojectable-fact and empty incoming success. Empty neighbors is not native none.
findings.consequence: Author findingCount 0 cannot be read as atom/query known-miss agreement. Peer matching evidence, not verdict, is the occupancy-agreement proof for this scoped review.
findings.minimalRemedy: If later tightened, assert predicate value and matchingFactIds identity, and state that unmapped findingCount 0 plus verdict pass is non-blocking unknown, not none. Not a MUST occupancy identity defect.
